<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 114.068 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈113.0608 Da. The formula C₆H₉O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 113.060255 Da, matching the observed mass within a few ppm, making it the best candidate.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
